assets.name: u-boot-sunxi-with-spl.bin
assets.license: GPL-2.0-or-later (U-Boot); repository tooling has no observed license grant
assets.reproducibility: SOURCE KNOWN / BUILD NOT YET REPRODUCED
assets.notes: FEL-loaded bootloader (BROM eGON header + SPL + U-Boot + DTB). Embedded banner 'U-Boot 2022.01-dirty (Sep 13 2026 - 12:27:18 +0000)' identifies the release build; UBI/UBIFS commands are enabled because arch/arm/Kconfig implies CONFIG_CMD_UBI when CONFIG_MTD_RAW_NAND=y. Rebuilt from pinned source: all bytes match except the uImage header time field and its derived CRC (5 bytes), because this image embeds two independent build timestamps; the release is explained, not bit-reproduced by the unmodified recipe.

assets.name: u-boot-dtb.bin
assets.license: GPL-2.0-or-later (U-Boot); repository tooling has no observed license grant
assets.notes: U-Boot payload written to NAND at 0x800000 after deterministic zero-padding to one erase block; see the derived artifact u-boot-dtb-padded.bin. Bit-identical rebuild from u-boot v2022.01 d637294e + x-chip-uboot 0e17d16 patches/nand.cfg + Debian bookworm toolchain (gcc 12.2.0, binutils 2.40) with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH pinned to the release banner time.

assets.name: sunxi-spl.bin
assets.license: GPL-2.0-or-later (U-Boot); repository tooling has no observed license grant
assets.notes: BROM SPL (eGON.BT0, sun5i-r8-chip). Bit-identical rebuild under the same pinned inputs and SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH. One released SPL serves both NAND parts; per-part NAND images are generated with sunxi-nand-image-builder (OOB 1664/1280).

assets.notes: Debian 13 rootfs assembled 2026-07-29 (boot.scr embedded time 2026-07-29T02:01:37Z) from live Debian mirrors and the CHIP apt repo state published at 2026-07-29T01:54Z (x-chip-deb-repo 40a8723); the source commit 7584eab is dated 2026-07-24. Kernel, DTB and boot script are derived from this archive.

derived_artifacts.name: vmlinuz-6.12.94+deb13-chip
derived_artifacts.notes: Recovery kernel extracted from the pinned rootfs at the recorded path; hash computed from the released archive. No separate upstream URL exists.

derived_artifacts.name: sun5i-r8-chip.dtb
derived_artifacts.notes: Base device tree extracted from the pinned rootfs; compiled with __symbols__ so the PocketCHIP overlay can apply. Identical copy also installed under usr/lib/linux-image-6.12.94+deb13-chip/.

derived_artifacts.name: boot.scr
derived_artifacts.notes: Installed boot script extracted from the pinned rootfs; generated by flash-kernel from the x-chip-os bootscr.chip template. Loads kernel at 0x42000000 and DTB at 0x43000000 from UBIFS, applies the DIP overlay, then bootz with no initrd.

derived_artifacts.name: x-chip-pocketchip.dtbo
derived_artifacts.notes: PocketCHIP device-tree overlay shipped in the rootfs; rebuilt byte-identically from CHIP-dt-overlays e79aee33 and installed from the chip-dt-overlays 0.8 deb.

derived_artifacts.name: u-boot-dtb-padded.bin
derived_artifacts.transform: zero-pad to 4194304 bytes (upstream: dd bs=4194304 conv=sync)
derived_artifacts.notes: Deterministic zero-padding of the locked u-boot-dtb.bin to 4194304 bytes; the NAND payload written at 0x800000.

physical_roles.purpose: Raw NAND SPL image for the SK Hynix H27UCG8T2ETR part (OOB 1664)

Upstream publishes no such binary. Batch 1 must either generate deterministically (fixed padding) and record hashes or decide the role is derived rather than a downloaded asset.
